title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
abstract: arXiv:2611.33417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. Moreover, flow matching is formulated as an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), whose deterministic trajectories do not naturally support RL optimization. Introducing stochasticity by converting the entire trajectory into a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) is a common practice. Nevertheless, not all timesteps contribute to the final outcomes, and redundant exploration introduces additional noise. Furthermore, in multi-objective settings, some objectives may dominate the optimization while others receive insufficient updates. translated_title: 面向三维分子设计的强化学习引导连续-离散流匹配的时间选择性探索方法
translated_abstract: 流匹配在生成任务中展现出了强大的潜力，然而通过强化学习（RL）对其进行优化仍然缺乏深入研究，尤其是在连续-离散混合的设置中。此外，流匹配被表述为常微分方程（ODE），其确定性轨迹并不天然支持强化学习优化。将整个轨迹转化为随机微分方程（SDE）以引入随机性是一种常见做法，但并非所有时间步都对最终结果有贡献，冗余探索会引入额外噪声。而且，在多目标设置中，某些目标可能主导优化过程，而其他目标则得不到充分的更新。在本研究中，我们提出了一种带有时间选择性探索的强化学习引导连续-离散流匹配框架，用于三维从头分子设计。具体而言，我们的方法联合优化连续和离散……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种带时间选择性探索的强化学习引导连续-离散流匹配框架，通过仅在关键时间步选择性注入随机性以减少冗余探索噪声，并平衡多目标优化中的更新不均问题，从而实现高效的三维从头分子设计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a temporal selective exploration framework for RL-guided continuous-discrete flow matching, which selectively injects stochasticity at key timesteps to reduce redundant exploration noise and balances multi-objective updates for efficient 3D de novo molecular design.
